positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Worked on the infrastructure team, maintaining and improving Clinc's CI/CD pipeline,
interfacing with other teams to incorporate their innovations, and conducting design and
code reviews
• Designed an alternative containerized deployment model of Clinc's on-premises
software using systemd, enabling contracts with two major financial institutions
worth $1.2M
• Contributed to building a containerized, Django-based template server for business logic
using Docker, empowering customers to build custom integrations with the Clinc AI
platform
• Integrated an open-source bot into Clinc's GitLab CI/CD pipeline, automating and
eliminating toil related to merging in a rebase-based workflow
• Collaborated with stakeholders to design, build, and deploy custom integrations,
enabling the Clinc AI platform to seamlessly fit into their workflows
• Provided remote and on-site support for on-premises deployments, troubleshooting
complex production issues and ensuring smooth deployments for clients
